name: Grand Grimoire Chronicles Episode 4
author: Addicting Games
description: Grand Grimoire Chronicles Episode 4 is a free escape game. There is a big dark house at the end of a long dark street. Somewhere inside is the answer to a mystery. People are talking about it 'who is Elizabeth' and 'what is her secret.' Everybody wants to know what the big dark secret just might be and it is up to you to follow your nose, collect the clues, put them together to solve the puzzle.  You'll figure it out if you spend enough time gathering the clues. There are so many clues and items in this escape room style dialog driven . Probably some of the best clues you'll ever read. But you gotta do something with them, you gotta take them and you gotta put them together and you gotta come up with a solution or its game over.  This is a mystery puzzle-style game that will put you to the test, the ultimate retro, 8-bit mystery game.  If you want to pass it and you want to be the hero you're gonna have to work hard cause it's not easy but it's fun. It's a good time.
